label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Five-Way RBC Canadian Open Lead
items.text: Sahith Theegala, Emiliano Grillo, Eric Cole, Brooks Koepka, and Sam Burns are tied at -6 after Round 1 at TPC Toronto (North Course).

items.headline: Phil Mickelson Banned from San Diego Club
items.text: Phil Mickelson was banned from The Farms Golf Club near San Diego for alleged nonconsensual physical contact; the club took decisive action after an independent investigation.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Eyes PGA Tour Return
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau is reportedly seeking a return to the PGA Tour amid LIV Golf's funding crisis and tough return terms including a $5M charity payment.
